blocks.text: Architecting a High-Performance Cloud Environment for a VLSI Design Leader
Manufacturing
Client
A leader in semiconductor design and VLSI application development.
Ambition
To move from a limited on-premise data center to a scalable, high-performance cloud environment to support their complex, computer-aided engineering (CAE) workflows and accelerate project timelines.
Outcome

Architected and migrated the client to a transformative, cloud-centric environment that provided on-demand, high-performance computing, fostering an ecosystem of real-time analytics and smarter integrations.
The Ambition
A leader in semiconductor design and VLSI application development.
The Challenge

Their existing on-premise data center could not keep up with their growth. The lack of on-demand computing resources was a major bottleneck, leading to significant project delays. They also grappled with a scarcity of data storage, which was critical for their extensive archiving requirements. The limitations of their IT infrastructure were creating significant inefficiencies for their development and QA teams.
The Architectural Blueprint

The client's ambition was to eliminate the infrastructure bottlenecks that were stifling their growth. They needed a modern, flexible environment that could accommodate increasingly complex project demands, provide scalable and secure long-term data storage, and support their hybrid workforce model without causing project delays.
Ambition, Realized

The shift to a cloud-centric environment ushered in a new era of operational excellence. The enhanced scalability allowed them to seamlessly manage intensive CAE workloads, eliminating the previous project delays. The solution led to significant cost efficiencies and provided a fertile ground for advanced custom coding and automation, completely revolutionizing their operational model and accelerating their innovation.
Key Business Impact
Eliminated Infrastructure Bottlenecks & Project Delays
Enabled On-Demand High-Performance Computing for CAE
Achieved Significant Cost Efficiencies
Fostered an Ecosystem of Real-Time Analytics & Automation
